verdict.rationale: Cloudflare provides a local simulator (workerd/wrangler) and CLI tooling (npm create cloudflare, Wrangler commands) that let developers spin up and test isolated Worker instances quickly, and Workers' isolate-based architecture naturally supports concurrent, isolated executions. However, there's no explicit evidence of a built-in unlimited multi-environment/preview-deployment system for whole-team parallel shipping (e.g., per-branch preview URLs), so support is inferred rather than demonstrated.
